coordinate_system.convention: Local scene frame. South (lake/view side) = negative Z. East = positive X. Y up. rotation_y_deg about Y.
coordinate_system.note: Same frame as neighbourhood-scene-v0.2.json so Platform can drop these elements straight into the scene graph.

evidence_policy.statement: No legal boundary, buildable envelope (BYA/BTA), access or terrain gate is closed. Finished-floor (Y=0 datum) is provisional flat-plot; do not treat any dimension as engineered or permitted.

upgrades_requested.unlocks: slope + fall line -> confirm/deny west-end souterräng upgrade; set finished-floor
promote Glan view REPORTED_UNVERIFIED -> DERIVED per south window at eye height

design_intent.parti: L-plan longhouse: heated E-W bar on the south (lake) frontage; cold garage/service wing steps north off the east end; west side left open to WNW summer-evening sun; SW terrace corner sheltered by a built vindficka windbreak.

drivers.south_view_and_winter_sun: Glan view az 185 + winter noon alt ~7.9deg both point south -> south glass bar
drivers.evening_sun: summer sunset az ~320 (WNW) -> keep west open; social zone at west end
drivers.wind: prevailing SW + lake breeze -> vindficka glazed windbreak at SW terrace corner; north wing screens NE/E
drivers.envelope_economy: garage as cold wing shortens heated perimeter; compact footprint de-risks open BYA gate
drivers.slope_agnostic: correct on flat datum; west-end walk-out is a conditional upgrade only if DTM confirms south fall >= ~2.5 m

elements.label: Prefab wet-service core (House Heart) at the L hinge
elements.rationale: Central hinge = shortest water/waste/vent runs; collapses systems complexity into one checkable, twinnable core (systems truth-law).

elements.label: Glanrummet — west view/evening room (the one move)
elements.feature: Fully glazed south+west; glazing splayed toward lake (structure stays orthogonal).

elements.label: SW glazed windbreak + planting (the grafted 'heart')
elements.rationale: Blocks SW gust; keeps WNW evening sun; no added heated floor.

elements.label: Optional phase-2 sauna/guest pod by the water (graft from D)

conditional_upgrades.condition: DTM_1M shows south fall >= ~2.5 m across HOUSE_BAR footprint
conditional_upgrades.effect: Drop Glanrummet/west social end to a walk-out lower level onto TERRACE_SOUTH; add lower-level slab below Y=0. Do NOT model until DTM closes.
